# Top AI development companies in Dubai for enterprise projects (2026)

For enterprise AI projects in Dubai, I’d shortlist companies based on their ability to deliver **secure, scalable, production-ready AI**—not just prototypes or chatbots. The right partner should be able to integrate AI with your existing ERP, CRM, data warehouse, and business workflows, while addressing data privacy, governance, and ongoing support.

Recent UAE industry roundups highlight a mix of enterprise technology providers, AI specialists, and global consulting firms. Their strengths vary considerably, so the best choice depends on your project scope. Website: [ibm.com/consulting](https://www.ibm.com/consulting)

## 2\. Which company should you choose?

| Your enterprise requirement | Best starting shortlist |
|--------|--------|
| AI integrated with ERP, CRM, and legacy systems | GBM, Accenture, Alpha Data |
| Private or data-sensitive generative AI | Core42, IBM Consulting |
| Predictive analytics and operational intelligence | Presight, Dataiku |
| A custom AI product or business application | Hidden Brains |
| Enterprise-wide AI transformation | Accenture, GBM, IBM Consulting |


These are recommendations based on service fit, not independently verified rankings of delivery quality.

## 3\. What to check before signing a contract

For enterprise projects, I would evaluate each shortlisted vendor against these six criteria\:

- **Production experience\:** Ask for two or three comparable projects already deployed in production, preferably in your industry.
- **Integration capability\:** Confirm experience with your ERP, CRM, APIs, data warehouse, and identity-management systems.
- **Security and compliance\:** Establish data residency, access controls, encryption, audit logs, retention policies, and applicable UAE data-protection requirements.
- **Ownership\:** Clarify who owns custom code, prompts, fine-tuned models, documentation, and other deliverables.
- **Operational support\:** Agree on uptime, incident response, monitoring, model evaluation, and maintenance responsibilities.
- **Commercial transparency\:** Request itemized costs for discovery, development, cloud or model usage, integration, and ongoing support.

A practical procurement approach is to ask your top three candidates to scope the same paid proof of concept, with agreed acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes. That makes technical capability and total cost much easier to compare.

## 4\. My recommendation

For a large enterprise programme, start with **GBM, Accenture, and Core42**\. For a data science or analytics-led programme, include **Presight and Dataiku**\. If the main deliverable is a custom-built AI application, include **Hidden Brains** in the evaluation.

Before treating any company as a final choice, verify its current project references, delivery team, contractual terms, and relevant security certifications. Public company lists alone cannot establish which vendor will perform best for your specific project.

**What kind of enterprise AI project are you planning?** For example, an internal AI copilot, customer-service automation, document processing, predictive analytics, or a custom AI platform. If you share the use case and approximate budget in AED, I can narrow this to the three most suitable providers.

## 3\. What to check before signing a contract

For enterprise projects, I would evaluate each shortlisted vendor against these six criteria\:

- **Production experience\:** Ask for two or three comparable projects already deployed in production, preferably in your industry.
- **Integration capability\:** Confirm experience with your ERP, CRM, APIs, data warehouse, and identity-management systems.
- **Security and compliance\:** Establish data residency, access controls, encryption, audit logs, retention policies, and applicable UAE data-protection requirements.
- **Ownership\:** Clarify who owns custom code, prompts, fine-tuned models, documentation, and other deliverables.
- **Operational support\:** Agree on uptime, incident response, monitoring, model evaluation, and maintenance responsibilities.
- **Commercial transparency\:** Request itemized costs for discovery, development, cloud or model usage, integration, and ongoing support.

A practical procurement approach is to ask your top three candidates to scope the same paid proof of concept, with agreed acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes. That makes technical capability and total cost much easier to compare.

## 4\. My recommendation

For a large enterprise programme, start with **GBM, Accenture, and Core42**\. For a data science or analytics-led programme, include **Presight and Dataiku**\. If the main deliverable is a custom-built AI application, include **Hidden Brains** in the evaluation.

Before treating any company as a final choice, verify its current project references, delivery team, contractual terms, and relevant security certifications. Public company lists alone cannot establish which vendor will perform best for your specific project.

**What kind of enterprise AI project are you planning?** For example, an internal AI copilot, customer-service automation, document processing, predictive analytics, or a custom AI platform. If you share the use case and approximate budget in AED, I can narrow this to the three most suitable providers.
